catalyst.name: Supercharged Magazine, Coldheart Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Passively grants 20 Stability and 20 Reload Speed.
(Yes, these are the same stats that are set to 100 when at 100% Fusion Energy)
Refills 5% of the magazine (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds while Amplified.
Activating Speed Booster increases this rate to once every 0.25 seconds, and allows the perk to overfill the magazine up to double its base capacity.

multiplier.expr: 1 + $clarity[Cold Fusion]("up to 80%") / 100 / (($clarity[Cold Fusion]("charged to 100%") / $clarity[Cold Fusion]("grants 40% energy") + $clarity[Cold Fusion]("a 0.267 second delay")) * $quantum[specials-trace-rifle-coldheart].timing.fireRateRpm / 60)
multiplier.note: per stack (perStack): the damage grows linearly with the energy, so 80 % over the hits that fill it (100 / 40 % per second plus the 0.267 s delay, times the hits per second)

durationMs.note: seconds to milliseconds; every hit renews it, a pause of that length (a reload) cools the weapon down

maxStacks.expr: ($clarity[Cold Fusion]("charged to 100%") / $clarity[Cold Fusion]("grants 40% energy") + $clarity[Cold Fusion]("a 0.267 second delay")) * $quantum[specials-trace-rifle-coldheart].timing.fireRateRpm / 60
maxStacks.note: hits until the energy is full: (100 % / 40 % per second + 0.267 s) x hits per second
